openwrt_hwdata.Comments_: B2 appears to only be different in labeling. The default firmware claims B1 and even /proc/cpuinfo claim to be B1 revisions even though the packaging and the sticker say B2 (see devicepage);

Known Hardware Versions.C2: same as C1?, works with C1 images
Known Hardware Versions.G1: not supported (same basic hardware as E1, FCC KA2IR825G1)

openwrt_wiki.Note B2: B2 appears to only be different in labeling. The default firmware claims B1 and even /proc/cpuinfo claim to be B1 revisions even though the packaging and the sticker say B2.
openwrt_wiki.WARNING: The DIR-825 series is prone to hardware failure of the Ethernet ports. There are numerous reports of this model developing problems with its LAN + WAN ports.

Info.Ethernet: RealTek RTL8366S Gigabit w/ port based vlan support
Info.USB: Yes 2 x 2.0 (Only 1 header to the outside)

openwrt_wiki.Installation: GUI OEM firmware update page (since OEM 2.05WW Build 05Beta01 not possible; 2.01EU likewise) or D-Link recovery mode (hold reset while powering up until power LED blinks orange, ~45 s; static IP 192.168.0.100/24, http://192.168.0.1; needs old browser or C program). There is no working 24.10.1 factory image; use 23.05.5 image, then sysupgrade.
openwrt_wiki.OEM Flash Layout Rev B: S25SL064A 8192KiB: u-boot 256KiB, config 64KiB, firmware 6208KiB (kernel 1024KiB + rootfs 5184KiB), caldata 64KiB, unknown 1600KiB (caldata_copy 64KiB)
openwrt_wiki.OpenWrt Flash Layout (22.03.5): u-boot 0-0x40000, config 0x40000-0x50000, fwconcat0 0x50000-0x660000, caldata 0x660000-0x670000, fwconcat1 0x670000-0x800000; virtual_flash firmware 0x7a0000
openwrt_wiki.Physically breaking into: Remove the two back rubber feet (closest to ethernet ports and antennas), unscrew the two screws underneath, pry case halves apart from back to front. Board: unscrew two front inner screws, remove LED shield, lift board from front and slide out forward.
openwrt_wiki.Serial: PIN1-->3.3V, PIN2-->RX, PIN3-->TX, PIN4-->GND; 'Remember to use 12V<->3.3V serial port voltage converter or you might break the router by over-voltage.' COM 115200, 8, 1, none, none
openwrt_wiki.LEDs: 11 blue and 2 orange LEDs; LAN LEDs controlled by switch (RTL8366S); D-Link, Power (blue/orange), Planet (blue/orange), WLAN 2.4, WLAN 5, LAN 1-4, USB, WPS
openwrt_wiki.Buttons: Reset (back, needs small item to push), WPS (right side, or top when standing, finger-operable, LED integrated, named powersave)
openwrt_wiki.Hardware Mods: Second USB port: solder two bridges in place of L66, add USB header/female A connector. 128 MB RAM mod with 2x Samsung K4H511638D-UCB3 (32Mx16), needs WNDR3700 bootloader/caldata.
openwrt_wiki.Fat images: Since Attitude Adjustment beta 2 '-fat' images moved caldata to end of flash (ar71xx).
openwrt_wiki.Tags: GigabitEthernet 5Port 2NIC USB 1USB JTAG 802.11abgn_simultan detachableantenna 2Ant 2WNIC ath9k 64RAM 8Flash MIPS MIPS32 24Kc

openwrt_wiki_foto_b1.Beschreibung: Platine im Unterteil, Antennenseite unten: 2 RP-SMA-Buchsen links und rechts an der Rückseite, mit Koaxkabeln zu U.FL-Steckern auf der Platine; zwei WLAN-Module unter Abschirmblechen (oben rechts); Ethernet-Übertrager HN4826CG (2x) und HN2409CG; Reset-Taster und DC-Buchse an der Rückseite; unbestückte Lochreihen oben links (2-reihig) und eine 4-polige Lochreihe nahe der Beschriftung JMP_START; Aufkleber 20101250167 3 E22.00...

openwrt_git_mac.Titel: ath79: fix label MAC address for D-Link DIR-825B1
openwrt_git_mac.Text: The label MAC address for DIR-825 Rev. B1 is the WAN address located at 0xffb4 in caldata, which equals LAN MAC at 0xffa0 incremented by 1.
